outcome: severe retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) (type 1 or type 2 ROP)
cohort: The study included 14,670 very preterm infants admitted to 70 neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) in the Chinese Neonatal Network who underwent ROP screening.
finding: The study identified a high incidence of severe ROP in very preterm infants in China and determined several associated risk and protective factors, with intravitreal anti-VEGF injection being the preferred treatment.
